label: Allegro
terms_note: Any Allegro account with 2FA can register an app at apps.developer.allegro.pl (no approval workflow documented); REST API terms require a custom User-Agent 'AppName/Version (+docsURL)'; 9,000 requests / minute per client id (429 when exceeded, some resources stricter + leaky-bucket per user); sandbox at allegro.pl.allegrosandbox.pl.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (authorization code, device flow, DCR; client credentials for public data; access 12 h, refresh 3 months rolling)
sdks: OpenAPI/Swagger spec published on developer.allegro.pl/documentation (client generation); no official SDK named on the pages opened

rate_limits: requests-per-minute throttling, headers to monitor (numbers not on the page read)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the audit
auth: 1. Register the app at https://apps.developer.allegro.pl (account with 2FA; sandbox apps at apps.developer.allegro.pl.allegrosandbox.pl) → Client ID + Client Secret.
2. Authorization-code flow (redirect the seller to Allegro, exchange the code) or device flow for headless clients; Dynamic Client Registration for self-installed instances.
3. Access token 12 h; refresh token 3 months, rolling on every refresh; tokens die on password / e-mail change or account lockdown.
4. Scopes per resource, e.g. `allegro:api:sale:offers:write`, `allegro:api:orders:read`; client-credentials tokens only for public resources (categories).

endpoints.purpose: create an offer bound to a catalogue product
endpoints.notes: product id / GTIN match, price, stock, delivery + return policies; async 202 with GET /commands/{id}
offer ids + new prices; reports via commands
checkout forms with buyer, delivery, payment

reference.limits: 9,000 requests / minute per Client ID (Software Statement ID for DCR); 429 when exceeded, access restored after the window; some endpoints stricter; leaky-bucket throttling per user on selected resources (developer.allegro.pl/about). - Custom User-Agent header 'AppName/Version (+docsURL)' is mandatory for identification. - Sandbox use rules: no illegal content, no attacks (except Bug Bounty). - No formal app approval documented for private or public apps; seller consents through OAuth.
mcp_sdk: SDK: OpenAPI/Swagger spec published on developer.allegro.pl/documentation (client generation); no official SDK named on the pages opened

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your app registered at apps.developer.allegro.pl; sent with the secret as HTTP Basic on the token call.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client Secret of the same app.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time authorization-code (or device-flow) consent of the seller account (valid 3 months). It is SINGLE-USE: every refresh returns a new pair (access token 12 h + new refresh token) and the old refresh token stops working 60 seconds after its first use. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. Without the state directory, a restart after the first refresh needs a fresh refresh token.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency of your offers' base marketplace, PLN for allegro.pl; used by update_listing for sellingMode.price {amount, currency}.

me.note: GET /me (scope allegro:api:profile:read) returns the authorised user {id, login, firstName, lastName, email, baseMarketplace, company}.

update_listing.note: PATCH /sale/product-offers/{offerId} edits only the fields sent: name (12-75 characters, at least 3 words), sellingMode.price {amount as the documented string, currency from the config field — pass `price` whenever currency is configured}, stock.available. `description` is a structured sections object and is not mapped. Answers 200 (edited) or 202 (accepted, still processing; see GET /sale/product-offers/{offerId}/operations/{operationId}); the offer body is in raw.

end_listing.note: PUT /sale/offer-publication-commands/{commandId} with a fresh UUID command id and {offerCriteria: [{offers: [{id}], type: CONTAINS_OFFERS}], publication: {action: END}} ends the offer (reversible with action ACTIVATE). The command runs asynchronously: 201 returns {id, taskCount}; the result is at GET /sale/offer-publication-commands/{commandId}/tasks.

set_inventory.note: PATCH /sale/product-offers/{offerId} {stock: {available}} sets the offer's stock. `listing_id` (offer id) is required; Allegro offers are not addressed by SKU. An active offer needs stock > 0.

list_orders.note: GET /order/checkout-forms?offset&limit(1-100)&fulfillment.status(NEW|PROCESSING|READY_FOR_SHIPMENT|READY_FOR_PICKUP|SENT|PICKED_UP|CANCELLED|SUSPENDED|RETURNED)&lineItems.boughtAt.gte(ISO-8601) (scope allegro:api:orders:read). Returns {checkoutForms[], count, totalCount}; `status` is the seller fulfillment status (the purchase status BOUGHT|FILLED_IN|READY_FOR_PROCESSING|CANCELLED is raw.status), `total` is summary.totalToPay.amount (a decimal string), created_at the first line item's boughtAt.

mark_shipped.note: POST /order/checkout-forms/{id}/shipments {carrierId, waybill} (scope allegro:api:orders:write) adds a parcel tracking number to every line item of the order (lineItems omitted = all items, as documented). `carrier` must be an Allegro carrier id from GET /order/carriers (e.g. INPOST, DPD, DHL, POCZTA_POLSKA); OTHER additionally needs carrierName, which is not mapped. The seller fulfillment status is a separate call (PUT /order/checkout-forms/{id}/fulfillment {status: SENT}) and is not changed here.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /sale/product-offers needs productSet[{product: {id, idType: GTIN|PRODUCT_ID}}] (an Allegro catalogue product, or a new product with category.id and the category's required parameters[]) plus delivery {shippingRates.id}, afterSalesServices policies and stock; the vocabulary has no product identifier, category or policy ids, and creation may finish asynchronously (202 + operation polling).
not_offered.listing_metrics: No per-offer visits or sales statistics call in the REST API reference (swagger.yaml has /sale/offer-events and classified-ad statistics only).
